citation.authors: Abdallah M, Arters F, Patel J, Edwards C et al

cited_by.title: A low white cell count that may be Duffy-null (neutrophil count)

record.population: Duffy-null Black people and dose decisions
record.design: Search for trial evidence that Duffy-specific reference ranges are safe
record.finding: I found papers on febrile neutropenia in Duffy-null patients with myeloma (Abdallah 2024, abstract not retrievable) and on CDK4/6 inhibitors in breast cancer (Ferri 2025, not opened). I could not confirm trial evidence for safe use of Duffy-specific thresholds. UNVERIFIED.
record.note: Title only seen in search; the abstract returned empty from PubMed.
